spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five Combats of Wisdom Against Falsity

---

**¶1**

Those who dwell in wisdom from the Divine waged five spiritual combats against those who dwell in falsity from evil. In every combat, those in wisdom overcame and subjugated those in falsity.

---

**¶2**

The first combat is that of the primordial Divine Good descending into the natural mind, which it waged against the ruling evil that governs the states of falsity, and all the dominant falsities that had proceeded from the five corporeal faculties of [GAP-1] evil. The Divine Good ensnared them by means of its encompassing truth, which is the living divine influx itself. It [GAP-2] in the entrapment of falsity, and [GAP-3] the appearance of the [GAP-4] its pure celestial affection, the ardor of divine love [GAP-5] — the falsities could find no means to escape the encompassing power of truth, [GAP-6] and it caught them as natural knowledges are seized from the waters of the external mind [GAP-7]. The five fundamental purposes of the five natural faculties [GAP-8] were laid open. The Divine Good severed and uprooted the origin of the five modes of perverted perception, [GAP-9] the source of every false perception arising from self-love, as the power of truth cuts at the very root.

---

**¶3**

The second combat is that of divine truth proceeding from the Divine Good [GAP-10]. It established the forms and states of heavenly order; it dispersed the dominant falsities and restrained them within the bonds of divine law [GAP-11], setting the knowledges of good and truth in [GAP-12] the natural states of the mind [GAP-13], confining them within the three containing degrees of the mind — natural, spiritual, and celestial. For the dominant falsities rose up in rebellion and set themselves against the proceeding divine truth. They wished to [GAP-14] — since they recognized and perceived that it had power to bind and fetter them with the unbreakable constraint of divine order. Yet the proceeding divine truth appeared before them in manifold modes of operation, with innumerable [GAP-15] powers, with many instruments of omnipotence and with the severity of divine judgment against evil. It was made manifest to them, and it imprisoned them by the infinite wisdom of providence. Not one falsity was able to preserve itself, and it {GAP-16}[GAP-17] [GAP-18]. Now, since it [GAP-19] it ensnared them [GAP-20] [GAP-21].

---

**¶4**

The third combat is that of the divine truth making itself visible in the human form, which displayed the image of the Divine [GAP-22] to the states that are below [GAP-23]. It drew forth [GAP-24] all wisdom and its attendant goods [GAP-25] from those states that are consumed by evil [GAP-26]. The entire dominion of evil [GAP-27] — the glory of wisdom [GAP-28] — extending itself [GAP-29]. A state of divine power comes, which is mighty [GAP-30]; it strips from evil its appropriated knowledges [GAP-31], its truths [GAP-32], its self-love and concupiscence.

---

**¶5**

This is what the dominion of evil is like [GAP-33] — all its appropriated knowledges [GAP-34] — as they pass through successive states [GAP-35], the wisdom within them [GAP-36] is separated. The Divine Good cleansed and purified it, discerning good from evil and truth from falsity.

---

**¶6**

The fourth combat is that which divine truth in its fullness and glory waged against all the falsities that had rebelled in both interior and exterior states of the mind. When wisdom had been separated from them through the manifestation of the divine human form, their external restraints were loosened [GAP-37]. The glorious divine truth, in this fourth combat, came and brought [GAP-38] a rising up of the entire dominion of evil. It girded itself with the armor of truth [GAP-39] and encompassed the whole of it a second time. It established the complete order of the heavens, and it effected [GAP-40] a great spiritual contest in which every falsity was overcome. [GAP-41] It fulfilled the purpose of the Divine itself, [GAP-42: REVIEW — it bestowed] the promise of regeneration upon the first human will [GAP-43], guiding it toward the doctrine that conveys and contains all wisdom.

---

**¶7**

The fifth combat is that which the guidance of divine providence [GAP-44] — which is the calling forth of divine truth and the will's reception of it — [GAP-45] the great [GAP-46] accomplished. And it set [GAP-47] upon the [GAP-48] and the [GAP-49] [GAP-50] of spiritual death, which [GAP-51] by means of it. And it was victorious over [GAP-52] to eternity, and it bestowed the Lord's kingdom [GAP-53] upon all who received it.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The sons of light waged five wars against the sons of darkness. The sons of light humiliated the sons of darkness in them all.

The first war is that of the First living Man, which he waged against the King of the realms of Darkness, and all the rulers that had come forth from the five worlds of [darkness]. He hunted them with his net, which is the living soul. He [caught them] in the snare and [revealed] the face of the [soul] his virgin, the living fire [and] they did not find how to escape his net [and] he caught them like fish [in the sea] the five counsels of the five elements [of darkness]. He cut and dug out the root of the five trees, [and the] root of the evil tree, like an axe.

The second war is that of the Living Spirit [...]. He has constructed the things and the worlds of light; he spread out the rulers and chained them in the middle [of the heavens and set] the stars in [the firmament and] the earths [and placed] them in the three vessels. For the rulers rebelled and were set against the Living Spirit. They wished to [flee] since they knew and realised that he might bind and fetter them with a strong chain. Yet he, the Living Spirit, (appeared to them) with many aspects, with numerous [forms], with many hands and great cruelties. He was revealed to them, he imprisoned them with much skill. Not one of them was able to save (himself), and he [bound][...]. Now, since he [was wise] he trapped them [...] [...].

The third war is that of the Third Ambassador who has displayed his image [to what is above and to] what is below [and he] scooped [out] all light and the property [from] the ones that are consumed [by darkness] the entire ruling-power [was stripped of the] pride of the light [which was] extending it [...]. A person comes, who is powerful [over him]; he takes his riches [his gold], silver [...], his pride and wantonness.
This is what the ruling-power is like [...], all riches [...] as they travel [through the heavens, the] light [is separated from them]. He cleansed and purified it.

The fourth war is this that Jesus the glorious one waged against all the rebels who had rebelled above and below. When the light was purified from them by the image of the Third Ambassador, their chains loosened [and they rebelled]. The glorious one in the fourth war; he came and brought [to an end] a rebellion of the entire ruling-power. He girded himself [and encompassed] all of it another time. He constructed the whole structure and he made [of it] a great contest; he humiliated therein. [And] he fulfilled the will of the greatness, [he gave the] hope to Adam [and led him] to his light ship.

The fifth war is this that the counsel of life [has waged] which is the summons and the obedience [and the] great [work] and it placed [...] upon the [...] and the [...] [...] of death, which [was overcome] with it. And it was victorious over [death] for ever, and it gave the kingdom [to the sons of light]

fills.explanation: The "five worlds of darkness" is the standard Manichaean designation for the five realms of evil (Smoke, Fire, Wind, Water, Darkness), corresponding to the five corporeal faculties of evil in the spiritual reading.
The First Man hunted the rulers with his net; the spiritual reading says he entrapped them in the snare of falsity, so "caught them" continues the hunting metaphor.
The spiritual reading says he manifested the appearance of his celestial affection; "revealed the face of" fits the First Man unveiling his light element against the darkness.

The Living Soul is the collective name for the First Man's five light elements (his armour); "the face of the soul, his virgin, the living fire" specifies the particular element revealed, and in Swedenborg the soul's inmost quality is pure celestial affection.
Simple connector bridging the description of the living fire to the statement that the rulers could not escape, matching the dash-transition in the spiritual reading.
Connector bridging the statement about escaping the net to the fish simile, as indicated by the conjunction in the spiritual reading.
The spiritual reading specifies "from the waters of the external mind," and the fish simile naturally requires a body of water; "in the sea" completes the metaphor.
The five counsels belong to the five elements of darkness, paralleling "five worlds of darkness" in GAP-1; the spiritual reading calls them "five natural faculties" which are the dark faculties.
Connects the cutting of the root of the five trees to the root of the evil tree; the spiritual reading treats the evil tree's root as the collective source of all false perception from self-love.
The Living Spirit chained the rulers in the middle of the heavens (the firmament) and then set the stars; the spiritual reading says "within the bonds of divine law, setting the knowledges."

The Living Spirit set stars in the firmament and arranged the earths below; the spiritual reading places the knowledges (stars) in a higher order preceding the natural states (earths), matching firmament-above-earths cosmological structure.

Bridges the earths to "them in the three vessels"; the spiritual reading says "confining them within the three containing degrees," and "placed" describes the Living Spirit's act of cosmic arrangement.
The rulers wished to flee because they knew the Living Spirit would bind and fetter them; the spiritual reading implies attempted escape from the constraint of divine order.

The Living Spirit appeared with many aspects and numerous forms; the spiritual reading says "innumerable powers," and in Manichaean texts the Living Spirit manifests in manifold forms to overpower the archons.
After none could save themselves, the Living Spirit bound them; this continues the imprisonment theme and the spiritual reading's emphasis on binding falsities with divine order.
Completes the verbal phrase begun by GAP-16 ("bound them"), referring to the rulers/falsities that could not save themselves.
The text earlier states he imprisoned them "with much skill"; the spiritual reading implies the trapping came from infinite wisdom, so "was wise" provides the causal quality enabling the entrapment.

fills.fill: to what is above and to
fills.explanation: In Manichaean cosmology, the Third Ambassador displays his beautiful image to the archons bound above (in the firmament) and below (on earth); the spiritual reading confirms the image is shown to states above and below.
Transitional connector bridging the display of the image to the action of scooping out light, with the Third Ambassador as the continuing subject.
The spiritual reading says "drew forth," and "scooped out" is the natural-register equivalent describing the extraction of captured light from the archons.
The light and property are taken "from" the consumed ones; the spiritual reading says "from those states that are consumed by evil."

The spiritual reading says "consumed by evil," and in the Kephalaia's natural register, "evil" is consistently rendered as "darkness"; this completes the passive construction describing the archons consumed by the dark substance.

The Third Ambassador's image causes the ruling-power to be stripped of its captured light; the spiritual reading describes the dominion of evil losing the glory of wisdom, and "stripped" fits the robbery analogy that follows in the same paragraph.

Relative connector linking "pride of the light" to the participial phrase "extending itself"; the spiritual reading uses a dash indicating apposition, and "which was" forms the natural relative clause bridging them.

The analogy echoes the Gospel parable of the strong man (Mark 3:27): a person comes who is more powerful than the possessor and strips him; "powerful over him" specifies the superior power of the divine agent over the ruling-power being plundered.

Gold and silver are the standard pair of precious substances; the spiritual reading lists "appropriated knowledges" (riches) then more specifically goods (gold) and truths (silver), matching Swedenborg's gold-good, silver-truth correspondence.

In Manichaean cosmology, captured light is purified by traveling through the cosmic machinery of the heavens (the ships and wheels); the spiritual reading's "successive states" corresponds to the heavenly spheres through which light ascends toward purification.
The spiritual reading says "the wisdom within them is separated," describing the light being extracted from the consumed rulers before the Divine Good cleanses and purifies it in the next clause.

When the Third Ambassador purified light from the rulers, their chains loosened and they rose up in rebellion, necessitating the fourth war; the spiritual reading describes the loosening of external restraints leading to the uprising.
Jesus came and brought to an end the rebellion of the ruling-power; the spiritual reading describes divine truth coming to subdue the rising up of the entire dominion of evil.
The spiritual reading says he "encompassed the whole of it a second time"; Jesus girded himself and encompassed all of the rebellion once more, re-establishing divine order.

Jesus turned the rebellion into a great contest; "he made of it a great contest" means he transformed the uprising into a decisive spiritual battle, matching the spiritual reading's "effected a great spiritual contest."
Simple transitional conjunction linking the description of the contest to the fulfillment of the will of the greatness, as the spiritual reading indicates a continuous narrative.
The editor's suggestion "he gave the" matches the spiritual reading's "it bestowed"; Jesus bestowed the hope of regeneration upon Adam, and the phrasing fits the Kephalaia's natural register.
The spiritual reading says "guiding it toward the doctrine that conveys all wisdom"; in Manichaean narrative Jesus awakens and guides Adam, and the "light ship" is the vessel of saving doctrine.
Follows the pattern of the other war descriptions ("which he waged," "who has displayed"); the counsel of life "has waged" its war through the summons and obedience.
Connects "the obedience" to "great work" as another attribute of the counsel of life; the spiritual reading indicates a great deed was accomplished through the summons and obedience.
The spiritual reading says the great thing was "accomplished"; "the great work" describes the total operation of the counsel of life in the fifth war.
The spiritual reading says death was conquered "by means of" the counsel of life; "was overcome" fits the chapter's theme of successive victories and the defeat of spiritual death.
The immediately preceding context concerns "the power of death," and the final victory of the fifth war is over death itself; the spiritual reading confirms victory over spiritual death to eternity.

The chapter's framing (¶1) contrasts the sons of light with the sons of darkness; the spiritual reading says the kingdom was given "upon all who received it," and in the Kephalaia's register these are the sons of light.
